text:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: Elevated p50/p99 token-latency and increased 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Affected service: runtime-gpu-pool. Trigger: latency > 250ms (p99) for 3m. Link: https://mon.redwood/alerts/ALERT-5112

maya (oncall): seeing it, paging eng-sre and eng-runtime. investigating initial scope.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T09:45:02 UTC started to slice-traffic (staged rollout) -> slice-id=slice-e2, image=v2.14.3.

josh (sre): noted correlation with deploy-bot timestamp. early signal: kernel fallback events spiking on hosts in slice-e2.

sasha (eng-runtime): on it. grabbing runtime logs and kernel selection trace for the slice. any customer reports yet?

cassie (customer-success): we have an enterprise customer (acme-corp) reporting degraded chat response times and some 500s since ~09:46. They're asking if this is a rollbackable issue.

maya (oncall): pls treat as P1. sasha/josh coordinate mitigation. lena, advise on staged rollout rollback path. thomas, prep customer comms template.

sasha (eng-runtime): initial grep of agent logs shows lots of lines like: `kernel_fallback: selecting slow_generic_kernel for attention_blk type=multihead, seq_len=1024` and repeated `batch_window_expired` entries. small batches + fallback -> high per-token latency.

josh (sre): metrics: KV cache hit-rate dipped 30% for requests with long context. batching rate dropped ~60% after deploy -> throughput collapse.

sasha (eng-runtime): hypothesis: new kernel selector change in v2.14.3 has a regression for certain transformer configs (mixed quant + fused-attn path). It prefers fallback path under prefetch concurrency pattern.

lena (prodops): recommended immediate mitigation: 1) flip feature flag `prefetch-mode` -> off for slice-e2 2) if no quick improvement, rollback slice-e2 to previous image. Which is faster?

josh (sre): flip flag first (fast), then rollback if latency doesn't improve in 2 minutes.

sasha (eng-runtime): agreed. executing flag flip for slice-e2 now: `ffctl set --slice slice-e2 runtime.prefetch=false --actor=sasha --note="mitigating kernel fallback"`

sasha (eng-runtime): done. waiting on metrics.

(30s)

josh (sre): metrics: p50 down from 180ms -> 120ms, p99 down from 820ms -> 260ms. 5xx rate dropping. KV hit-rate recovering. Good sign.

cassie (customer-success): I told acme-corp we're applying a fix and will monitor; they acknowledged. :thumbsup:

maya (oncall): keep flag off and hold. Sasha, root-cause triage. Josh, prepare rollback plan in case. Thomas, send short note to affected customers (we patched a runtime setting, monitoring).

sasha (eng-runtime): collecting more diagnosics. found a spike in `batch_size=1` events after the rollout, tied to new scheduling heuristics. new selector reduced microbatch aggregation thresholds which exposed a fallback path for quantized attention.

josh (sre): attaching a short log snippet from node-14 in slice-e2: ```
[09:46:11] request id=abcd1234 batch_size=1 choose_kernel=generic_fallback latency=410ms
[09:46:11] kv_cache_miss
[09:46:12] batch_window_expired current_window=8ms
[09:46:13] attach_kernel=fast_fused_attn (fallback failed)
```

lena (prodops): if flag keeps latency stable for 15m, we can continue rollout with flag disabled and schedule a hotfix for v2.14.4. Recommend we stop advancing slice rollouts for the day.

maya (oncall): agreed. hold rollout, pause staging rollout policy. deploy-bot, pause further slices.

deploy-bot: Paused further staged rollout slices. slice-e2 frozen at current traffic.

(10m)

josh (sre): stability holds for 10m, p99 ~240-280ms, throughput recovering. No further 5xx spikes.

cassie (customer-success): acme-corp says response times look better. asking for RCA and ETA for permanent fix.

sasha (eng-runtime): action items: 1) revert kernel selector change in mainline for attention path OR add guard for quantized models 2) add test to simulate microbatch patterns at scale 3) add monitoring alert for sudden drop in batching aggregation rate. I'll open PR for hotfix v2.14.4.

josh (sre): ops actions: 1) refine rollback playbook timings 2) add a rollback knob to console to flip rollout to previous image faster 3) create runbook step to flip runtime.prefetch flag scoped to slices.

maya (oncall): I'm handing off to eng-runtime and prodops for next-phase mitigation and RCA. I'll mark incident as "mitigated" and keep the channel open for postmortem notes.

lena (prodops): scheduling a follow-up postmortem meeting in 24h. I'll include SRE, runtime, deploy, and CS.

cassie (customer-success): I'll send an email to acme-corp with what we changed and a heads-up about the postmortem.

thomas (support): we should search support queue for other similar reports since the rollout window. I'll surface anything urgent.

sasha (eng-runtime): PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/5678 - hotfix branch with selector revert + added microbatch guard. testing now.

maya (oncall): nice work. closing paging loop. Reopen if regression returns. :hand: 

[thread_status]: mitigated, rollback not required (flag flip success). follow-ups scheduled: hotfix PR, rollout pause, improved alerts.
